automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.rule: Public sources must display an unambiguous publication or update date within the prior 48 hours. Date-only sources at the lower boundary are excluded.

federation.collector_boundary: Keep only local AI-assisted-development practice implications; do not create local entity coverage.

qualifying_updates.title: AI Scan for pull requests generally available
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub made AI Scan for pull requests generally available. When enabled with code scanning, it reports advisory AI findings beside CodeQL findings, including a risk explanation and possible autofix; it does not fail the code-scanning check or block merge through rulesets.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Treat AI-assisted PR security findings as a separately labeled advisory signal: route them to an accountable reviewer, retain their outcome, and do not represent an AI scan as a merge gate unless an independent policy and deterministic required check provide that authority.
qualifying_updates.follow_up: Route to normal raw ingest only if a maintainer wants an explicit local rule separating advisory AI findings from enforced acceptance gates.

qualifying_updates.title: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts general availability
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub's agentic autofix explores relevant files, proposes a remediation, reruns CodeQL, and opens a draft pull request with the fix rationale and validation steps. The feature requires enterprise policy enablement, organization or repository enablement, a defined billing method, and consumes AI credits and Actions minutes.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: A governed remediation loop should preserve the alert scope, code-search evidence, validation output, cost budget, approval state, and draft-review boundary. A successful tool rerun supports review but does not replace human merge authority or broader regression checks.
qualifying_updates.follow_up: Route to normal raw ingest only if a maintainer wants a durable controlled-remediation pattern; keep GitHub product facts upstream.

excluded_candidates.title: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles in public preview
excluded_candidates.reason: Relevant reproducible-CI and supply-chain practice, but the displayed date is at this run's lower boundary without a precise publication time; excluded rather than inferring 48-hour qualification.

excluded_candidates.title: The EU's next chapter in AI is agentic
excluded_candidates.reason: Date-only lower-boundary source. Its aggregate adoption data also needs a separately scoped local operating-model interpretation before it can become local practice guidance.

excluded_candidates.title: Designing a bounded review loop
excluded_candidates.reason: Useful practice guide, but the date-only lower-boundary publication cannot be qualified precisely for this 48-hour run.

excluded_candidates.title: HydraFusion updates and new Max option
excluded_candidates.reason: Date-only lower-boundary listing and broad upstream-owned product/model coverage; no distinct local practice evidence was extracted.

excluded_candidates.title: GitHub App improvements for least privilege and management
excluded_candidates.reason: Outside the strict 48-hour window; least-privilege implications are not enough to override the date evidence.

excluded_candidates.title: AI code review: news and analysis
excluded_candidates.reason: Secondary aggregation of social discussion rather than a primary source; its date-only lower-boundary date is also insufficient.

excluded_candidates.title: AI code review extension sent pasted code to a server unasked
excluded_candidates.reason: Secondary summary of a reported extension finding, with a date-only lower-boundary date; retain no claim without the primary research source and precise timing.

excluded_candidates.title: Agent Runs from Claude Code: Workflow Runs, Facts and Usage
excluded_candidates.reason: Qualifying date, but this is product-specific documentation for an upstream-owned MCP server and does not establish a separate general local-practice update.

follow_up_notes: Collector remains raw-only: do not update docs/wiki or move this artifact to raw/processed in this run.
If ingesting the AI Scan item, preserve its advisory-only status and keep enforcement authority in an independent acceptance gate.
If ingesting the agentic autofix item, capture the draft-PR review boundary, policy enablement, validation evidence, and cost budget separately from broad GitHub product facts.
Recheck the excluded October 14 sources only if their authoritative pages expose a precise publication time that proves qualification after the cutoff.
